contact.basis: Fixed SW local[-12,12] before all floors/sections/geometry; provider-relative unsurveyed source datum.

verticalDatum: Public Terrarium composite source heights; provider-relative host visualization, not a surveyed local datum.
attribution: Mapzen terrain tiles; NASA/USGS and other open elevation sources
method: Original Terrarium RGB24 bytes bilinearly sampled at pixel centres in fixed native whole Courtrai Newfoundland Memorial frame. Independent field frozen before any model geometry, without flattening or fitting.
limitations: Terrarium zoom15 output pixels may oversample much coarser native DEM.1.5625m review grid and RGB encoding are not survey accuracy.

Urban source relief may contain building/canopy artifacts and does not resolve tower foundations or exact doorway thresholds. Exact construction-grade classification is unspecified; source field does not certify ground contact.
